items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Wild Bill Davis, Bobby Hackett.

ctx.x: And Wild Bill Davis, Bobby Hackett. A lot of the guys go down -- they did go down and work as soloists with the local trio.
And it was a good place to work. I understand they've changed the policy now to maybe have some of the modern music in there, or whatever is current -- commercially, you know.
